title: Licensee
description: Distribution licensee and service territory. See docs/data/INDIA_CI_TARIFF_DATA_STRATEGY.md section 5.1.

code.description: Short licensee code, e.g. BESCOM, MSEDCL.

service_territory.description: Free-text or geo reference describing the licensee's coverage area.

licensee_type.description: MUNICIPAL covers municipal-body distribution (e.g. BEST, NDMC). SPECIAL_AREA covers cantonment/special-area licensees (e.g. Military Engineer Services in Delhi Cantonment).

coverage_tier.description: TIER_A: mainstream state-owned/major-private/municipal distribution licensee serving a normal geographic retail area. TIER_B: extended C&I coverage (deemed/SEZ/industrial-area/port/airport/campus/parallel licensees). TIER_C: historical, renamed, merged, surrendered, unconfirmed or proposed entities, tracked but never presented as active.

c_and_i_relevance.description: Materiality of this licensee's territory for HT/LT industrial and commercial tariff analysis.

shares_schedule_with.description: Code of another licensee (licensees.yaml) whose tariff schedule this licensee shares, when applicable (e.g. licensees under a common holding company using one filed schedule).

shared_tariff_group_id.description: ID of a shared_tariff_group (see docs) when several licensees are governed by one common commission-approved schedule, e.g. multiple state DISCOMs on a single MYT order.

predecessor_licensee_ids.description: Codes of licensees (licensees.yaml) this licensee succeeded via restructuring, merger or renaming.

successor_licensee_ids.description: Codes of licensees (licensees.yaml) that succeeded this licensee, if applicable (e.g. this record is TIER_C/historical).

overlap_licensee_ids.description: Codes of other licensees (licensees.yaml) with an overlapping or parallel service territory (e.g. a deemed licensee inside a state DISCOM's area).

parent_licensee_id.description: Code of the parent distribution licensee (licensees.yaml), when this record is a franchisee rather than an independent licensee. A franchisee must not be represented as independent unless regulatory evidence confirms distinct licensee status.

verification_status.description: VERIFIED: confirmed against an authoritative source in the section-4 hierarchy. PROVISIONAL: discovered but not yet confirmed against a primary source. UNVERIFIED: not yet checked. DISPUTED: conflicting authoritative evidence found.

confidence.description: Confidence in the accuracy of this record given the evidence found.

last_verified.description: Date a human/agent last confirmed this licensee's identity/status against an authoritative source.

evidence_url.description: Authoritative source URL supporting this licensee's existence/details.

authoritative_source_ids.description: Codes of sources.yaml entries providing evidence for this record.
